tool_args.rationale: The pilot is monotone and concave in u_now, while the added measurements vary s_grad broadly and show gradient-associated suppression. Fit the barrier-modulated siphon law numerically to all seven paid rows; the prior failed only because its prediction parameters were not initialized by fit, corrected here.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All current observations are at H=0.6, but the paid responses vary systematically with u_now and s_grad; a slow-horizon probe would test temporal adaptation rather than resolve the observed gradient-linked response.
The evidence does not contain varied initial states or trajectory data to support an ODE; this higher-cost probe is unnecessary for the current static response pattern.
These are plausible concave alternatives, but the wide s_grad range and associated response changes support fitting the four-parameter gradient-modulated barrier siphon to all observations.
